title: BlockReplacer
description: Mass replace blocks with simple creative commands whole world or a selected area, with a wand, live progress, counting and undo/redo.
body:
# BlockReplacer

Replace blocks in bulk with simple creative commands. Everything works in creative mode and is fully undoable.

## Commands
- Use /blockreplacer, /br or /blockrep:
  
- /br world <from> <to> — replace a block type in all loaded chunks
- /br world all <to> — replace every (non-air) block
- /br area <from> <to> — replace inside your wand selection
- /br area <from> <to> <c1> <c2> — replace inside a coordinate box
- /br area all <to> [c1 c2] — replace every block in the selection/box
- /br count <block> | /br count all — count blocks (no changes)
- /br undo | /br redo — up to 5 steps each
- /br stop — stop a running operation (partial result stays, can be undone)
- /br wand — get the selection axe (left-click = corner 1, right-click = corner 2)
- /br messages on|off — toggle info messages

## Features
- Keeps position and orientation 1:1 — only the block type changes
- Attached blocks like torches are not knocked off
- Live progress in chat for large operations

## Requirements
- Fabric Loader
- Fabric API
